prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?

best AI video ad maker for your exact use case
answer_verbatim:
There is **no single best** AI video ad maker for every use case, but the strongest all-around picks in the results are **HeyGen** and **Creatify**. HeyGen is ranked best overall for ads in one review because of avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation, while Creatify is repeatedly selected as the best overall for fast, high-volume product and ecommerce video ads.[1][2][7][14]

If you want the shortest practical answer:

- **Best overall for most ad workflows:** **HeyGen**[1][17]
- **Best for ecommerce/product ads:** **Creatify**[2][7][15][16]
- **Best for UGC-style performance ads:** **Arcads**[4][10]
- **Best for short-form ad editing/workflows:** **Revid.ai**[20]
- **Best budget-oriented all-rounder mentioned:** **AdCreate** or **HeyFish**, depending on whether you value broader tool coverage or lower starting price.[3][12]

A useful way to choose is by ad type:
- **Avatar-led, multilingual, testimonial-style ads:** HeyGen.[1][17]
- **Product-url to video, ecommerce, many variations:** Creatify.[2][7][10]
- **UGC-style actor ads:** Arcads.[4][10]
- **Short-form social ad editing:** Revid.ai.[20]
- **Brand-consistent campaign work from your own assets:** ngram is highlighted for that use case.[5]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best AI video ad maker for your exact use case** such as ecommerce, Meta ads, TikTok, YouTube, or lowest cost.
